functions.name: ThreadSafeWrapper
functions.summary: Thread-safe file seek wrapper: acquires the stream critical section, performs a seek via FileSeekWithModeFlagValidation, releases the critical section, and returns the seek result.

operations.description: StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a1) acquires the stream critical section before the seek.
v4 = FileSeekWithModeFlagValidation(a1, a2, a3, a4) performs the seek operation on the locked stream.
Returns v4, the integer result of the seek.
